fragment.runtimeAssets: public/<kind>/<slug>/ (no index.html here; the shell owns the URL)

types.kind: string, must equal the folder kind
types.slug: string, kebab-case, must equal the folder slug
types.title: string, no date stamp (the shell renders '· created · updated')
types.shell: doc | card (default doc): the design the same body renders in. doc = pages in a left sidebar, the page's <h2 id> sections in the bar, its headings in a right sidebar; card = hero, tab bar and rail on the content card. Optional per tab: data-rd-group (sidebar group), data-rd-sub (page subtitle)
types.source: { project: string, build: string } (the build hash)
types.icons: string[] — Lucide names the page creates in page.js (not in the body markup); the shell adds them to the sprite

body.tabbed: top-level <section data-rd-tab="id" data-rd-label="…" [data-rd-icon="…"]>; ids equal today's ?tab= values
allowed: pre-rendered Mermaid diagrams (self-contained <svg id="mmd-…"> with an internal <style> and style= presentation attributes — the design system's own output; a documented exception to the no-<style>/no-style= rules)
forbidden: navbar, footer, comments, breadcrumb, hero, rd-expnav, rd-toc (the shell injects them)

pageJs.shape: export default init({ root, data, rd })
pageJs.events: rd.on('tabshow', …) for charts in hidden tabs
pageJs.history: a widget that keeps its state in the hash (#m=5&s=2) uses rd.nav.hash(h, { push, state }) and rd.nav.back(); put data-rd-hash on the widget so the Doc design keeps its section shown

data: over 100 KB goes to same-origin sidecar files; never base64 in HTML; shared assets under public/shared/<project>/
validator: pnpm check:export <dir> (dependency-free; copied into generator repos' CI)
